coach_turns.utterance: what should I eat for better sleep

unsupported_claims: Dinner ke liye khichdi ya dal with a vegetable stir-fry best option hai.
His teaching style focuses on alignment, breath, pranayama, and meditation.

raw.response:
Surya Namaskar, or Sun Salutation, is a sequence of 12 powerful yoga asanas best performed early morning on an empty stomach [PROG_Y_001]. A complete round consists of two sets, starting with the right leg and then the left [PROG_Y_001]. 

Each posture is coordinated with your breath, making it a very calming practice [PROG_Y_001]. 

Please note: If you have high blood pressure, a hernia, or back problems, you should consult a doctor or certified instructor before performing it [PROG_Y_001].

Anulom Vilom ke fayde niche diye gaye hain:

- Yeh mind ko calm karta hai aur stress relieve karne mein madad karta hai [PROG_P_001].
- Yeh body mein Tridoshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) ko balance karta hai [PROG_P_001].
- Yeh patience aur concentration ko improve karta hai [PROG_P_001].

Ek healthy lifestyle ke liye aap yeh diet plan follow kar sakte hain:

* Breakfast: Fried foods ki jagah poha, upma, ya idli opt karein [PROG_D_001].
* Lunch: 2 rotis, a bowl of dal, sabzi, aur a portion of salad le sakte hain [PROG_D_001].
* Dinner: Yeh lightest meal hona chahiye; khichdi ya dal with a vegetable stir-fry best option hai [PROG_D_001].
* Snacking & Hydration: Cravings manage karne ke liye nuts and seeds snack karein, processed sugar aur excessive salt avoid karein, aur daily at least 8-10 glasses of paani (water) zaroor piyein [PROG_D_001].

Kapalbhati, or Skull Shining Breath, is an invigorating pranayama that cleanses the body [PROG_P_002]. It involves active, forceful exhalations and passive inhalations while sitting with a straight spine [PROG_P_002]. Your stomach pumps inwards with each short, powerful breath [PROG_P_002]. Beginners can start with 20-30 pumps and do up to 3 rounds with breaks in between [PROG_P_002].

It stimulates the digestive system and improves metabolic rate, aiding in weight loss [PROG_P_002]. Practice it on an empty stomach, preferably in the morning [PROG_P_002]. Avoid Kapalbhati if you are pregnant, or have high blood pressure, heart disease, hernia, or epilepsy [PROG_P_002].

Trikonasana, or Triangle Pose, is a foundational standing pose that stretches the entire body [PROG_Y_003]. 

It stretches the hamstrings, hips, and spine, while strengthening the legs and core [PROG_Y_003]. It is also therapeutic for stress and helps improve digestion by stimulating the abdominal organs [PROG_Y_003].

To practice, hold the posture for 30-60 seconds without locking your knees [PROG_Y_003]. Please avoid Trikonasana if you are experiencing a headache, low blood pressure, or a neck injury [PROG_Y_003].

Garmi ke liye Sheetali Pranayama (Cooling Breath) perfect hai, jo body aur mind par cooling effect dalta hai [PROG_P_004]. 

Kaise karein:
- Aaram se baithkar tongue ko tube shape mein roll karein aur mouth se bahar nikalein [PROG_P_004].
- Tube ke through slowly aur deeply inhale karein, fir tongue retract karke mouth close karein aur nostrils se slowly exhale karein [PROG_P_004].
- Ise 5-10 times repeat karein [PROG_P_004].

Yeh pranayama hunger aur thirst control karne mein bhi madad karta hai [PROG_P_004]. 

Dhyan dein: Low blood pressure ya asthma jaise respiratory issues wale logon ke liye yeh recommended nahi hai [PROG_P_004]. Ise clean environment mein practice karein [PROG_P_004].

Immunity boost karne ke liye aap ye foods apni diet mein shamil kar sakte hain:

• Citrus fruits jaise amla, oranges, aur lemons Vitamin C se rich hote hain [PROG_D_002].
• Turmeric (haldi) mein curcumin hota hai; ise milk ya curries mein add karein [PROG_D_002].
• Ginger, garlic aur gut health ke liye Yogurt (probiotics) ka upyog karein [PROG_D_002].
• Green leafy vegetables jaise spinach (palak) aur Almonds (Vitamin E ka source) shamil karein [PROG_D_002].

Kisi ek food ke bajay balanced diet par focus karna zaroori hai [PROG_D_002].

Yogi Devvrat is our Head Instructor and a certified RYT 500 Yoga Alliance instructor with over 15 years of experience [PROG_I_001]. He started his yoga journey in Rishikesh, learning from traditional yoga gurus [PROG_I_001]. His teaching style blends classical Hatha yoga with modern Vinyasa flow, focusing on alignment, breath, pranayama, and meditation [PROG_I_001].

He specializes in therapeutic yoga to help clients manage chronic pain and stress-related ailments [PROG_I_001]. You can join his Sunrise Flow class every weekday at 6:30 AM [PROG_I_001].

Millets are ancient grains that are gluten-free and rich in fiber, protein, and antioxidants [PROG_D_004]. They are considered a modern superfood and include varieties such as:

- Ragi (Finger Millet): Rich in calcium, which supports bone health [PROG_D_004].
- Jowar (Sorghum): Packed with iron and protein [PROG_D_004].
- Bajra (Pearl Millet): Rich in magnesium, which supports heart health [PROG_D_004].

Because they are high in fiber and have a low glycemic index, millets keep you feeling full longer, aid in weight management, and are suitable for diabetics [PROG_D_004].

You can relax with these restorative yoga poses from our program:

* Balasana (Childs Pose): Kneel, sit on your heels, and fold forward resting your forehead on the floor with arms stretched out or alongside your body [PROG_Y_005]. Hold for 30 seconds to a few minutes with deep, diaphragmatic breathing to calm the brain and alleviate stress and fatigue [PROG_Y_005].
* Shavasana (Corpse Pose): Lie flat on your back, feet apart, arms at your sides with palms up, and release body tension and breath control [PROG_Y_004]. Stay aware and relaxed for 5-10 minutes; this calms the nervous system, helps reduce blood pressure, and combats insomnia [PROG_Y_004].

Dia Malik is a certified clinical nutritionist with a Master's degree in Food and Nutrition who has helped over 500 clients with weight management and conditions like PCOS and diabetes through diet [PROG_I_002]. 

She follows a no-deprivation approach, believing healthy food can be tasty, and specializes in creating sustainable, personalized meal plans rooted in Indian cuisine and your lifestyle [PROG_I_002]. 

You can book a one-on-one consultation with her on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 4 PM to 6 PM [PROG_I_002].

Paani peene ke mukhya fayde yeh hain:

- Yeh body temperature ko regulate karta hai, joints ko lubricate karta hai aur cells tak nutrients deliver karne mein madad karta hai [PROG_D_003].
- Yeh kidney function ke liye essential hai aur toxins ko flush out karta hai [PROG_D_003].
- Khane se pehle paani peene se full feel hota hai, jo weight management mein madad karta hai [PROG_D_003].
- Yeh headaches, fatigue aur poor concentration jaisi dehydration ki samasyaon se bachata hai [PROG_D_003].

Rozana 8-10 glasses of water peene ka aim karein [PROG_D_003]. Taste ke liye aap paani mein lemon, cucumber, ya mint leaves infuse kar sakte hain [PROG_D_003]. Pyaas lagne ka wait na karein, din bhar sip-sip karke paani piyein [PROG_D_003].
